title: After the Asahi Hai FS: The Rose Kingdom

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
("With victory as our cornerstone, eternal prosperity.
Peace and serenity like that of an unshakable 'kingdom.'")

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (—O Ancestor.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (I will carry on your will.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Together――with him!
choice_data_list: Victory! —I believe in you, Lady Rose!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Together――with her!
choice_data_list: Victory! —I believe in you, Lady Rose!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: HaaaaaaaaaAAAH—!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
It's Rose Kingdom!
—The clan's long-held wish has come true!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Wooooooooaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, aah! Aah!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—...Ngh, we won...! We won!
It is our... victory...!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: We've seized a GⅠ victory!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her raise her fist high—
I choke back the tears welling up in my chest.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!
choice_data_list: This is where our journey truly begins!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(You do not weep
as you did during your debut, do you?)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Naturally! Our Rose Kingdom
has only just begun to bud!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To dye the world in rose is our sworn duty!
Forward we march, together, into a brighter future—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —That night, a magnificent soiree was held at the Rose Clan manor.

text_block_list.name: People
text_block_list.text: “Congratulations, Lady Rose!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Truly a dreamlike night where roses danced.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every person and Umamusume belonging to the clan,
and all those connected to them,
sang and danced in joyous celebration—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One after another—they spoke of the future.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
With this, the name of the House of the Rose has...!
It has surely spread even further across the racing world!

text_block_list.name: Supporters' Association Member
text_block_list.text:
When is the next race scheduled?
I wish to offer even greater support toward our next victory!

text_block_list.name: Foundation Chairwoman
text_block_list.text:
Likely owing to the heightened attention surrounding the Rose Clan,
the number of guests wishing to stay at the training camp facility
we co-manage has surged dramatically...

text_block_list.name: Rose's Mother
text_block_list.text: Rose.

text_block_list.name: Rose's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You have achieved our long-cherished dream magnificently.
A beam of radiant light has shone upon our house.
Our ancestors surely rejoice as well. Above all—

text_block_list.name: Rose's Mother
text_block_list.text: You did wonderfully well.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Thank... you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: So here you are.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I gave a small nod of the head.
Unused to the role of being the star of the banquet,
I had escaped onto the balcony almost without thinking.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The training staff was looking for you.
You should check in with them later.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Before that, however... on a night such as this,
would you grant me a moment of your time?
choice_data_list: Would you like to discuss your race rotation?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: No, that is not it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She tilted her head gently, as if straining her ears to listen.
Lively conversation, laughter, the clinking of glasses,
and the soft, flowing melody of the orchestra.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: —Your hand.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It is a splendid evening.
Would you do me the honor of sharing a dance?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Moving to the light waltz drifting from afar,
Rose Kingdom gracefully steps.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A chilly winter night wind. The lights of the bustling floor and
the moonlight spilling from the sky softly illuminated her cheeks.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...—
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I cannot count how many times
I have dreamed of this very day.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
At times a dream. At times a curse.
The bind of thorns was ever woven into my future.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I have devoted every moment available to sharpening myself,
day after day, in order to sever this curse.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: There may well be curses I have severed with these legs, with this power. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her eyes narrowed softly, as though gazing upon something radiant.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: —The one who cleaved through the final thorns was you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I am proud to have accomplished the founding
of the Rose Kingdom alongside you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under that earnest gaze, I instinctively bow my head.
For she was the one who had guided me this far.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—
Let us accomplish it together. Everything.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The morning after the Asahi Hai FS, numerous media outlets covered the House of Roses fulfilling their long-cherished dream.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Rose Kingdom, who so magnificently broke free from the "Curse of Thorns"—
wasn't she simply splendid?!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: Yes! Up next, as expected, we are all eager to see what kind of performance the representative of the Rose clan will show in the Classic tier. It's truly thrilling—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Regarding our next objective, I wish to pursue
the Classic Triple Crown route as planned.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown route, where peerless glory awaits—
its opening clash will be the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The nation has been founded. Then what we must do next
is establish the prestige of the 'Rose Kingdom.'

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I believe that only beyond the accumulation of such devotion
does the eternity of our clan truly exist.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Thus, I wish to deliver results upon an extraordinary stage, and carve the name of the Rose dynasty into history.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I wish to carve out an unshakeable position in the racing world—not with a single victory, but with a second, and a third.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The second leg, the Japanese Derby,
is a truly special race that crowns the strongest of our generation.
I must claim it at all costs.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Rose Kingdom, achieving the Triple Crown is by
no means a dream. And should she accomplish it,
the Rose Clan's future will surely be bathed in light.
choice_data_list: Naturally, it shall be as you say.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Very well. First, let us dedicate ourselves toward the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, per her wishes,
we announced her entry into the Classic Triple Crown campaign.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That sight heightened the public's expectations of the Rose Clan
even further. And at the same time—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
I look forward to the day we can spend time together again.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, the Prince of Roses enters the fray as well. Still...
her performance in the Asahi Hai FS exceeded all expectations.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
To possess such capability at this stage...
A reevaluation of your training menu's intensity will be necessary.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a day when a new wind
began to blow once more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First up is the Satsuki Sho—
and so, our days of challenge begin!
